speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given your history of significant medical issues, this is likely an opportunistic infection caused by the JC virus, often associated with immunosuppression such as HIV/AIDS, B-cell lymphomas, or immunosuppressive therapy. Do you have a known history of HIV, lymphoma, or are you currently taking medications that suppress your immune system?
